ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic: total 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT for tests from 21 January 2026: 4.5 total with at least 4.5 in each component (old scale: 92 with 23 in each).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL-iBT (including Home Edition) from 21 January 2026: total 4.5 with at least 4.5 in each component.

deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year; most students start in October.
deadline.quote: Applications are welcome throughout the year.

supervisor.value: Contact potential supervisors to discuss your proposal or an advertised project before applying.
supervisor.quote: You should contact potential supervisors to discuss either your own research proposal or the advertised project you are interested in pursuing.

funding.value: Many applications are tied to funded scholarships; funding depends on the scheme.
funding.quote: Applications are welcome throughout the year, many of which are associated with funded scholarships.

entry_route.value: A UK 2:1 bachelor's degree or equivalent plus some research experience.
entry_route.quote: A UK 2:1 honours degree, or international equivalent, in a relevant subject.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.
